name: ClubMX Training Facility

soil.notes: Chesterfield sits in the Carolina Sandhills. Riders describe the ClubMX layouts as true sand, with one forum thread calling the sand track among the gnarliest in the US; a 2025 visitor said the dirt was unreal. Exact mix per track not published.

layout.notes: Pro-level training campus (founded 2010, about 200 acres) with multiple MX and SX tracks. Public riders mostly get the practice/front track, which riders call technical but rideable for amateurs and vets; a 2018 poster said it can feel tight.

conditions.dry: Sand ruts up deep during open practice; riders describe big jumps and deep ruts on the front track.
conditions.watering_prep: A 2018 forum poster said it is prepped and watered every weekend it is open.
conditions.seasonal: Private facility; public days are posted (fall/winter open practices and vet ride schools). Not open midweek to the public per 2022 poster.

rider_reports.says: Visitor at an open house called the facility special and the dirt outstanding; public riding mostly happens through winter, and the practice track is more technical but fine for amateurs and vets. Another poster said use may have shifted toward SX.
Thread on the ClubMX sand track: poster called it extremely gnarly sand and was humbled on a first visit; others compared it to European sand tracks.
Poster said ClubMX is prepped and watered every open weekend and is always on point, but can be a little tight and draws serious racers.
Youth rider's video says the front track has huge jumps and deep ruts.
